answer: Identity gating: each new identity posts a 50-POA bond co-signed by two unrelated sponsors from disjoint kin graphs. If clustering is proven within 6 epochs, all three bonds are slashed 100%. A farm therefore needs fresh external capital per fake (N fakes = 50*N POA plus sponsor recruitment), not one shared purse. Bonds that survive peer grading convert to non-transferable reef standing; failed grades keep umber locked and revoke vault attestation rights for 4 epochs.
